summary: Ethiopia's conservation commitments seek 30% forest cover by 2030, above the 21.7% forest share in the current land-cover map; community forest management involves over 2 million ha, 2.98 million ha of natural forest is reported conserved under sustainable management, and the sustainable-management area is targeted to reach 7.2 million ha by 2035. Urban green infrastructure is planned at 30% coverage in 240 towns by 2035. Restoration and mixed watershed actions include 5 million ha of watershed protection or rehabilitation and 100,000 ha of degraded mining-land rehabilitation by 2035; forest coverage is reported at 23.6%. Agricultural and mixed measures target 17.9 million ha of climate-smart rain-fed cropland by 2025—about 68% of the current mapped Agriculture area—and 1.8 million ha of climate-smart irrigation by 2035; forest-product output is expected to reach 11.0 million tons by 2035. The watershed pledge is about 4.4% of land area.
